lines.en: label chinamispring1:
scene chinamiwatching1
: Three...
: Two...
: One...
scene chinamiwatching2
: I am {i}not{/i} supposed to be wearing this yet!
lines.zh: : 我{i}还{/i}不该穿这个呢!

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching3
: She’s not supposed to be working right now either. But big sis Chika has had her priorities all kinds of messed up lately!
lines.zh: : 她现在也不该上班的。可 Chika 姐姐最近把轻重缓急全搞乱了!

lines.en: : Yeah...I can see that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我看得出来。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching4
: Okay! {i}Now,{/i} I can leave! Bye, guys! Be good! I’ll let you know when I’m on the way home!
lines.zh: : 好啦!{i}现在{/i}我可以走了!拜拜，各位!乖乖的!我回家路上会跟你们说的!

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching3
: {i}LET’S FUCKING GO FOR REAL THIS TIIIIIIIME!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这次是真的冲啊啊啊啊啊!{/i}

lines.en: The clopping of Chika’s boots as she sprints off toward the maid cafe fades long before I want it to. And as she disappears from her now home, I envision a future in which it is ours.
lines.zh: Chika 朝女仆咖啡厅飞奔而去的靴子声，消散得比我想要的早得多。而她从这个已是她家的地方消失时，我设想了一个未来——在那里，这也是我的家。

lines.en: Well...I guess, technically speaking, it {i}is{/i} ours. Just she’s not currently aware that I’m inhabiting such a place. And unless Chinami has ESP (Which is always a possibility), she’s unaware as well.
lines.zh: 好吧……严格来说，它{i}确实{/i}也是我们的。只是她目前并不知道我也住在这儿。而除非 Chinami 有超感知力（这可能性一直存在），她同样不知道。

lines.en: It’s strange and depressing how the last twenty-four hours have gone.
lines.zh: 过去这二十四小时的走向，既诡异又令人沮丧。

lines.en: I’ve spent time with two families who would openly allow me to insert myself into them (In any way I want) while neglecting the family I already have for reasons I can’t even properly explain.
lines.zh: 我和两个家庭待在一起，他们都会大方地接纳我融入其中（以任何我想要的方式），而我却冷落了自己本就拥有的家庭，理由连我自己都说不清。

lines.en: It’s not fear, is it?
lines.zh: 这不是恐惧吧?

lines.en: Responsibility?
lines.zh: 是责任吗?

lines.en: I’d say it’s just me being a terrible guardian, but that’s always been the case as {i}I’ve{/i} been the one being guarded instead.
lines.zh: 我倒想说只是我这个监护人太糟糕，可这一直以来都是如此——因为被监护的那个人其实是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: And when I’m most needed, I’m here — spending time with someone I have nothing in common with as an excuse disguised as obligation.
lines.zh: 而在我最被需要的时刻，我却在这里——陪一个和我毫无共同点的人，把这伪装成义务，实则是个借口。

lines.en: And as depressing as it is that the Chosokabes have lost both of their parents, the most depressing facet of all is that’s created a future in which {i}I{/i} could be Chinami’s father figure.
lines.zh: 长宗我部姐妹失去了双亲，固然令人沮丧，可最沮丧的是，这造就了一个未来——在那个未来里，{i}我{/i}可能会成为 Chinami 的父亲角色。

lines.en: And I would break her like the china doll she is, but she doesn’t see me that way.
lines.zh: 而我会像摔碎瓷娃娃那样毁掉她——她本就是个瓷娃娃——可她并不这么看我。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching5
Just look at her, completely trusting and vulnerable, when her fate lies entirely in my hands for the next eight or so hours.
lines.zh: 看看她，全然信任、毫无防备，而在接下来这八个小时左右，她的命运完全握在我手里。

lines.en: Does she not realize how easy it would be for me to snap? How many times it’s happened already? How {i}she{/i} could be the next Yumi or Molly and live the rest of her life scarred and traumatized?
lines.zh: 她难道不明白，我要崩溃有多容易？这种事已经发生过多少次了？{i}她{/i}又怎么可能不会成为下一个 Yumi 或 Molly，带着伤疤和创伤过完余生?

lines.en: Of course she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 她当然不明白。

lines.en: Because not only are those things beyond her understanding at this point in life-
lines.zh: 因为这些东西不只是超出了她这个年纪的理解——

lines.en: It’s that the “rest of her life” is questionable to begin with when she’s probably going to die before any one of us.
lines.zh: 更因为她大概会比我们任何人都先死，「余生」这个词本身就值得怀疑。

lines.en: But hey, maybe I’ll beat her there if the cards start favoring me soon. After all, they {i}do{/i} say that every dog has its day, and I’ve been nothing short of a bitch lately.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，要是运气很快站到我这边，也许我会比她先到。毕竟人家{i}确实{/i}说，凡人皆有得意时，而我最近活脱脱就是条母狗。

lines.en: : Arf!
But I guess Chinami is part-dog too.
lines.zh: 不过我猜 Chinami 也算是半个狗。

lines.en: I’m just not sure if death is what she’d order off the menu right now.
lines.zh: 我只是不确定，死亡是不是她现在会从菜单上点的那道菜。

lines.en: : Why are you barking without your helmet on?
lines.zh: : 你怎么没戴头盔就汪汪叫?

lines.en: : Chinami just felt like barking. Dogs do that sometimes.
lines.zh: : Chinami 就是想叫。狗有的时候会这样。

lines.en: : A lot of people say it’s because they can see ghosts, but Chinami isn’t sure she believes in them.
lines.zh: : 很多人说那是因为狗能看见幽灵，但 Chinami 不确定自己信不信。

lines.en: : Do you believe in ghosts, Papa?
lines.zh: : 爸爸相信幽灵吗?

lines.en: scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit1
scene chinamiwatching5
: Yes.
scene chinamiwatching6
: Really? Chinami is surprised to hear that! Chinami was sure that Papa was about to lecture her about imagination being stupid.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？Chinami 听了好惊讶!Chinami 还以为爸爸要训她，说想象力什么的很蠢。

lines.en: : It’s not stupid, it’s harmful. Plus, I don’t have the energy to lecture you about anything today. So I don’t really care about whatever your stance on dead people is.
lines.zh: : 不蠢，是有害。再说，我今天没力气教训你任何事。所以你对死人持什么立场，我真的不在乎。

lines.en: : Imagination is harmful? Why?
lines.zh: : 想象力有害？为什么?

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching7
: Well...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……

lines.en: : It doesn’t always have to be.
lines.zh: : 也不一定总是有害。

lines.en: : But it usually {i}is{/i} because engaging with it is like...spending time away from reality. And there’s no benefit to imagining {i}anything{/i} if the bulk of your life is going to be spent...you know, {i}living.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但通常{i}确实有害{/i}，因为沉溺其中就像……把时间花在远离现实的地方。而如果你人生的大部分时间都要用来……你知道的，{i}活着{/i}，那去想象{i}任何东西{/i}都没有好处。

lines.en: : But it can keep you entertained when things are boring. And if things are boring and you can’t use your imagination, what are you supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 可是无聊的时候它能让你不无聊啊。要是无聊又不能发挥想象力，那人该怎么办?

lines.en: : Either sit there and watch TV like you’re doing or engage in acts I can’t talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 要么就像你现在这样坐着看电视，要么就去做些我不能跟你谈的事。

lines.en: : Is Papa in a bad mood today? He seems a lot grumpier than he was just a minute ago.
lines.zh: : 爸爸今天心情不好吗？他看起来比刚才脾气差多了。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching8
: It’s been a tough week. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 这一周很艰难。抱歉。

lines.en: : Papa doesn’t need to be sorry! Chinami accepts Papa no matter who he is and how he feels! But Chinami might also just be saying that because she’s always lonely now and wants more company.
lines.zh: : 爸爸不用道歉!不管爸爸是什么样的人、心情如何，Chinami 都接受!不过 Chinami 这么说，可能也只是因为她现在总是很孤单，想要有人陪。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching9

: Big sis Chika has been working a lot while you’ve been gone so she can save up money for stuff. And big sis Yumi is...actually, Chinami doesn’t know what big sis Yumi has been doing. But she’s been busy too.
lines.zh: : 你不在的时候，Chika 姐姐一直在拼命打工，好攒钱买东西。而 Yumi 姐姐……其实 Chinami 也不知道 Yumi 姐姐在做什么。不过她也很忙。

lines.en: : Those two and Papa are the only people Chinami knows. Minus her business partner, Tsukasa, of course. But Tsukasa and Chinami are very different.
lines.zh: : 这两位，再加上爸爸，就是 Chinami 认识的全部人了。当然，还要减去她的生意伙伴 Tsukasa。不过 Tsukasa 和 Chinami 很不一样。

lines.en: : And you and I aren’t?
lines.zh: : 那我们俩就不一样了吗?

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t think so! Chinami thinks Papa is kind beneath his grumpy outside. And he loves big sis Chika just like Chinami does, so they have that in common.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得不是!Chinami 觉得爸爸在外面脾气坏，骨子里却很温柔。而且他跟 Chinami 一样爱 Chika 姐姐，所以这是共同点。

lines.en: : I think I {i}love{/i} her a little differently than you do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我对她的{i}爱{/i}，跟你的有点不一样。

lines.en: : Like you’re going to make babies with her? Because Chinami doesn’t know how to do that and will understand if that’s what makes you different.
lines.zh: : 就像你会跟她生宝宝那样？因为 Chinami 不知道怎么生宝宝，如果这就是你们不同的地方，她能理解。

lines.en: : Or did you mean something else?
lines.zh: : 还是说你指的是别的?

lines.en: : You were close enough. But I’ve also been rethinking just what “love” is lately, so who can say I have any idea what I’m even talking about at this point?
lines.zh: : 你猜得差不多。不过我最近也在重新思考「爱」到底是什么，所以谁敢说我现在知道自己到底在讲什么?

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching10
: Does Papa love Chinami?
lines.zh: : 爸爸爱 Chinami 吗?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不爱。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching11
: So quick! Chinami is hurt!
lines.zh: : 回答得这么快!Chinami 受伤了!

lines.en: : Like I said, the way I love things is different from how you love things. And it’s even worse because the things I love are always {i}wrong{/i} for me to love in the first place.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我爱东西的方式和你不一样。而且更糟的是，我爱的东西，从一开始就是{i}不该{/i}爱的。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching12
: Is it wrong for you to love big sis Chika?
lines.zh: : 爸爸爱 Chika 姐姐是错的吗?

lines.en: : It’s extremely wrong.
lines.zh: : 错得离谱。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Because I’m thirty-one. And she’s...
lines.zh: : 因为我三十一了。而她……

lines.en: : And that makes it bad?
lines.zh: : 就因为这样就不行吗?

lines.en: : Yeah. The only type of love I know how to have isn’t meant for girls her age. I should love people closer to mine.
lines.zh: : 对。我唯一懂得的那种爱，本来就不该给她这个年纪的女孩。我应该去爱年纪跟我更近的人。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks she understands. She watched a K-drama where a teacher kissed a student and everybody got mad. Is it like that?
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得她懂了。她看过一部韩剧，里面有个老师亲了学生，然后所有人都生气了。是那样吗?

lines.en: : Yeah...It’s like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……就是那样。

lines.en: : But it’s not bad because it makes other people mad. It’s bad because I should know better by now.
lines.zh: : 不过它之所以不对，不是因为会让别人生气。而是因为我这个年纪早该懂事了。

lines.en: : Why don’t you?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还不懂?

lines.en: : Because I’m an idiot, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 因为我是个白痴，Chinami。

lines.en: : But how did Papa become a teacher if he is an idiot? Is the educational system failing us? Is it good that Chinami is homeschooled?
lines.zh: : 可爸爸既然是白痴，是怎么当上老师的？是教育制度在害我们吗？Chinami 在家自学是不是件好事?

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching13
: Yeah. You’re a lot safer here. Even if it {i}can{/i} get pretty boring at times.
lines.zh: : 对。你在这儿安全多了。就算{i}有时候{/i}确实挺无聊。

lines.en: : That’s good. Because Chinami wants to be able to have good conversations with Papa, and she can’t do that if she isn’t smart.
lines.zh: : 那很好。因为 Chinami 想和爸爸好好聊天，可如果她不够聪明就做不到。

lines.en: : But maybe she can after all if Papa is dumb too. Chinami doesn’t know what to think right now. Her brain is moving in two different directions.
lines.zh: : 不过如果爸爸也笨，说不定她还是能聊。Chinami 现在不知道该怎么想。她的大脑正朝两个不同方向转。

lines.en: : Well, hey. We’ve got that in common too.
lines.zh: : 嘿，那这也算是我们的共同点了。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching14
: Like Chinami said! We have lots in common! Papa probably just doesn’t want to think so because he isn’t good at letting himself be happy.
lines.zh: : 就像 Chinami 说的!我们有很多共同点!爸爸大概只是不愿意这么想，因为他不擅长让自己幸福。

lines.en: : And how do {i}you{/i} know that? We barely even talk.
lines.zh: : 你{i}又{/i}怎么知道的？我们几乎没说过话。

lines.en: : Chinami overheard it!
lines.zh: : Chinami 偷听到的!

lines.en: : Chinami’s heard lots of stuff about Papa over the last two months. Big sis Chika’s been going kinda crazy and it’s making her say some weird stuff sometimes.
lines.zh: : 这两个月 Chinami 听到了很多关于爸爸的事。Chika 姐姐最近有点不对劲，让她有时候会说些奇怪的话。

lines.en: : What kind of weird stuff?
lines.zh: : 什么样的怪话?

lines.en: : Some stuff that makes her sound really smart. And then other stuff that makes her sound really insecure.
lines.zh: : 有些话让她听起来特别聪明。还有些话让她听起来特别没安全感。

lines.en: : Big sis Chika’s always been super strong and super confident. But when Papa wasn’t around, Chinami heard her blaming herself for it sometimes. And it was super-duper weird.
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐一直都超坚强、超自信。可爸爸不在的时候，Chinami 有时候会听见她为此责怪自己。那真是超级超级奇怪。

lines.en: : It wasn’t Chika’s fault at all...
lines.zh: : 那根本不是 Chika 的错……

lines.en: : Chinami knows that! Big sis Chika is too good at things to mess any of them up. So Chinami assumed Papa had other problems that nobody knew about. But that confused her too because her brain is small.
lines.zh: : Chinami 知道!Chika 姐姐做什么都太厉害了，不可能搞砸任何事。所以 Chinami 猜想，爸爸有别的、没人知道的问题。不过这也让她很困惑，因为她脑子小。

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi said you hate yourself, but Chinami doesn’t understand why. Is it because you love the wrong things? Like you said earlier?
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐说你恨自己，可 Chinami 不明白为什么。是因为你爱上了不该爱的东西吗？就像你刚才说的?

lines.en: : That’s definitely a part of it...
lines.zh: : 这肯定是其中一部分……

lines.en: : Will the other parts be easier for Chinami to understand?
lines.zh: : 那其他部分 Chinami 会比较容易懂吗?

lines.en: : Maybe in a few years, when your brain is bigger.
lines.zh: : 也许再过几年，等你脑子大一点就懂了。

lines.en: : Chinami hopes so. She wants all the people she loves to be happy together, even if they all love each other differently.
lines.zh: : Chinami 希望如此。她希望她爱的人都能一起幸福，哪怕他们爱彼此的方式各不相同。

lines.en: : And she was starting to worry that maybe you wouldn’t come see her anymore.
lines.zh: : 而且她开始担心，也许你再也不会来看她了。

lines.en: : It’s possible that’s true, Chinami. I need some time to myself to...think about things.
lines.zh: : 这有可能是真的，Chinami。我需要一点自己的时间……去想一些事。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching15

lines.zh: : 所以……

lines.en: : This might be the last time Chinami sees you?
lines.zh: : 这可能是 Chinami 最后一次见到你了?

lines.en: : Maybe. Maybe not. There’s no way of knowing for sure.
lines.zh: : 也许是，也许不是。没人能确定。

lines.en: : Huh...
: Chinami doesn’t like that.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : I didn’t expect Chinami to like that.
lines.zh: : 我也没指望 Chinami 会喜欢。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching16
A moment of silence washes over us as Chinami attempts to understand what exactly I mean by this. And that moment is reinforced by {i}me{/i} wondering the same exact thing.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默笼罩了我们，Chinami 试图弄明白我到底是什么意思。而{i}我{/i}也在琢磨同样的事，这让沉默更沉了。

lines.en: Just {i}I’m{/i} doing it earnestly. And Chinami is-
lines.zh: 只不过{i}我{/i}是认真的。而 Chinami 是——

lines.en: : I think that’s a bad idea, Papa.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是个坏主意，爸爸。

lines.en: Chinami is hard to understand sometimes.
lines.zh: Chinami 有时候真难懂。

lines.en: : If you stop coming here, big sis Chika might go crazy. And listening to her say sad and hurtful things about herself is very hard.
lines.zh: : 如果你不再来，Chika 姐姐可能会发疯。而听她说那些关于自己的伤心话、伤人的话，真的很不好受。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, there’s someone else I love going crazy at this very moment. But all of the things she says are hurtful toward other people.
lines.zh: : 嗯，可我爱的另一个人此刻正在发疯。不过她说的那些话，伤的都是别人。

lines.en: : Is she a bully like big sis Yumi?
lines.zh: : 她像 Yumi 姐姐那样是个恶霸吗?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : She’s just confused and scared.
lines.zh: : 她只是又困惑又害怕。

lines.en: : Your sister doesn’t need me the way she does. Like you said, Chika is really strong and really confident. And she’s done a great job when it comes to raising you.
lines.zh: : 你姐姐不需要我，不像她。就像你说的，Chika 真的很坚强、很自信。而且她把你带得很好。

lines.en: : There’s nothing {i}I{/i} can do for her that she can’t do for herself.
lines.zh: : 没有哪件事是{i}我{/i}能为她做、而她自己做不到的。

lines.en: : So it’s okay to hurt her?
lines.zh: : 所以伤害她也没关系吗?

lines.en: : It’s not {i}okay.{/i} That’s just kind of...how things happen when it comes to relationships sometimes.
lines.zh: : 这不{i}叫没关系{/i}。只是……感情里有时候事情就是会这样。

lines.en: : Should I stop calling you Papa?
lines.zh: : 那我是不是该改口，不叫你爸爸了?

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching17
: You never should have started in the first place...
lines.zh: : 你一开始就不该这么叫……

lines.en: : She won’t give up on you, you know.
lines.zh: : 她不会放弃你的，你知道的。

lines.en: : If you just stop coming here, she’ll follow you. Forever. That’s the type of person big sis Chika is.
lines.zh: : 如果你就这么不来了，她会追着你。追一辈子。Chika 姐姐就是这种人。

lines.en: : She’s loyal. And she cares about you as much as she cares about me. If you leave things open-ended, her feelings won’t just fade away. They’ll get bigger and scarier and more desperate.
lines.zh: : 她很忠诚。她关心你，就像关心我一样。如果你把事情悬着不解决，她的感情不会就此淡去。只会变得更庞大、更可怕、更孤注一掷。

lines.en: : If you don’t want to love her forever, that’s something you’ll have to tell her. If you don’t, it won’t ever actually end. And you’ll be running away for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 如果你不想爱她一辈子，那就得亲口告诉她。不说的话，这件事就永远不会真正结束。而你余生都得一直逃。

lines.en: : Now, I’m not saying that’s what I’m {i}going{/i} to do...but a thing you should know about me if you want to have “good conversations” is that I’ve already been {i}doing{/i} that for my entire life.
lines.zh: : 我这不是说我{i}打算{/i}这么做……不过如果你想跟我「好好聊天」，有件事你该知道：我这辈子{i}一直{/i}都在这么做。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Obviously because I don’t want what’s behind me to catch up.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为我不想让身后的东西追上来。

lines.en: : What’s behind you?
lines.zh: : 你身后是什么?

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching18
: A ghost.
lines.zh: : 一个幽灵。

lines.en: Another moment of silence creeps in. But this time, I know exactly what Chinami is thinking. I’ve known since the moment she let go of that childish persona again.
lines.zh: 又一阵沉默悄悄蔓延。但这一次，我完全清楚 Chinami 在想什么。从她再次卸下那副孩子气模样的那一刻起，我就知道。

lines.en: She’s concerned.
lines.zh: 她在担心。

lines.en: She sees the somewhat happy life she’s wound up with slipping away, and she’s worried that the future she’s spent so much time alone {i}imagining{/i} is going to be harmful after all.
lines.zh: 她看着自己好不容易得到的那份还算幸福的生活正在溜走，她担心那个她独自一人花那么多时间{i}想象{/i}出来的未来，终究是有害的。

lines.en: But more than that-
lines.zh: 但不止于此——

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching19
: Come here, Papa.
lines.zh: : 过来，爸爸。

lines.en: scene black
More than that, she’s worried about who will love her sister when she’s not there to do it anymore.
lines.zh: 不止于此，她更担心的是：等她不在了，还会有谁来爱她的姐姐。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching20
: Hi, Mama. Say hi to Papa.
lines.zh: : 你好，妈妈。跟爸爸打个招呼吧。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching21
: Mama says hi.
lines.zh: : 妈妈说你好。

lines.en: : Do I have to say hello back?
lines.zh: : 我也得回个招呼吗?

lines.en: : That would be the polite thing to do, yes.
lines.zh: : 那样比较有礼貌，是的。

lines.en: : Then...hello.
lines.zh: : 那……你好。

lines.en: : She can’t hear you. She’s just a picture.
lines.zh: : 她听不见的。她只是一张照片。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m aware, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我知道，Chinami。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching22
: And one day, Chinami will be “just a picture” too.
lines.zh: : 总有一天，Chinami 也会变成「只是一张照片」。

lines.en: : Picking the third-person act back up now that your mom is watching?
lines.zh: : 你妈妈看着呢，又开始用第三人称了?

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching23
: Chinami has no idea what you’re talking about! Her brain is small, remember?
lines.zh: : Chinami 完全不知道你在说什么!她脑子小，记得吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, sure it is...
lines.zh: : 是啊，当然小了……

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching20
: Chinami loves her new house. But her most favorite part of all is that they have a real altar now. And that Chinami can finally pay her proper respects to Mommy for giving Chinami a life.
lines.zh: : Chinami 很喜欢她的新家。而她最喜欢的是，她们现在有了真正的佛龛。Chinami 终于可以好好地感谢妈妈给了她生命。

lines.en: : She doesn’t want Mommy to blame herself for Chinami’s body not being perfect. Especially since Mommy’s body was never perfect either.
lines.zh: : 她不想让妈妈因为 Chinami 的身体不完美而自责。尤其妈妈自己的身体也从来都不完美。

lines.en: : She knows that sometimes, people just have bad luck. And that our luck was some of the worst ever.
lines.zh: : 她知道，有时候人就是运气不好。而我们的运气是史上最差的那种。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching21
: But that just makes big sis Chika seem even more lucky since {i}her{/i} body is super healthy and super pretty!
lines.zh: : 可这反而显得 Chika 姐姐更幸运了，因为{i}她{/i}的身体超级健康、超级漂亮!

lines.en: : Which is why it’s super important that she lives a happy, fulfilling life since neither Mommy nor Chinami will!
lines.zh: : 所以让她过上幸福而充实的人生才特别重要，因为妈妈和 Chinami 都做不到!

lines.en: : Chinami, you don’t know-
lines.zh: : Chinami，你不知道——

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching24
: I do, though.
lines.zh: : 不，我知道。

lines.en: : I don’t want to hide behind a mask forever. I want to be a normal girl...and do normal things.
lines.zh: : 我不想永远躲在面具后面。我想做个普通的女孩……做普通的事。

lines.en: : I want to know what you mean when you talk about different kinds of love. I want to make friends and go to the park and...
lines.zh: : 我想弄明白你说的「不同的爱」是什么意思。我想交朋友、想去公园，还有……

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching25
: And pierce my ears and...try out new parfaits at fancy cafes! I want to join a club and...and I want to eat peanuts!
lines.zh: : 还想打耳洞……想去高级咖啡厅尝新出的芭菲!我想参加社团……还有我想吃花生!

lines.en: : That last one is just asking to die, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 最后那一条简直是在找死啊，Chinami。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching26

: They’re {i}all{/i} asking to die because doing {i}anything{/i} with this body is putting it in danger. But sitting inside and watching Spongebob Squarepants for eight hours a day isn’t {i}living.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这些{i}全都{/i}是在找死，因为用这副身体{i}做任何事{/i}都是把它置于危险之中。可天天坐在屋里看八个小时海绵宝宝，那也不叫{i}活着{/i}。

lines.en: : None of this is {i}living.{/i} But I put up with it because I want my sister to be happy. I want her to have something she looks forward to when she comes home from work.
lines.zh: : 这一切都谈不上{i}活着{/i}。可我忍下来了，因为我想让我姐姐幸福。我想让她下班回家时，能有个盼头。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching27
: But there will be a time, whether we like it or not, when she comes home and I {i}won’t{/i} be here. And when that happens, I...
lines.zh: : 可总有一天，不管我们愿不愿意，她回到家时我{i}已经不在{/i}了。到那时候，我……

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching28
: I was hoping you would take my place.
lines.zh: : 我本来希望，你能接替我的位置。

lines.en: : Because I know you love her. I can feel it when you’re together. I can see the way you look at one another and...it’s even better than what I see in movies.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道你爱她。你们在一起的时候我能感觉到。我看得见你们看彼此的眼神，那……比我在电影里看到的还要好。

lines.en: : You might not be perfect...and you might hate yourself like big sis Yumi says...but I think you can learn to live with that if you keep at it long enough, Papa.
lines.zh: : 你可能不完美……也可能像 Yumi 姐姐说的那样恨自己……但我觉得，只要你坚持得够久，总能学会与它共处，爸爸。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know the ghost you’ve been running from your whole life, but she knows that big sis Chika wasn’t there to run with you until a little while ago.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不认识你一辈子都在逃的那个幽灵，但她知道，Chika 姐姐是不久之前才开始陪你一起跑的。

lines.en: : And no ghost is gonna mess with big sis Chika. She’s too strong.
lines.zh: : 而没有哪个幽灵敢招惹 Chika 姐姐。她太强了。

lines.en: : She’s too {i}lucky.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她太{i}幸运{/i}了。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching29
: Aaah! Crying always hurts Chinami’s head! Look what you made her do, Papa!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊!一哭 Chinami 的头就疼!看看你把她弄成什么样了，爸爸!

lines.en: : I know. But I’ve never claimed to be good at babysitting.
lines.zh: : 我知道。不过我可从没说过自己擅长带孩子。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching30
: How about tutoring, then?
lines.zh: : 那当家庭教师呢?

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching31
scene chinamiwatching30
: Papa is a teacher, right? Maybe he can make Chinami feel better by teaching her things while her big sister is at work?
lines.zh: : 爸爸是老师吧？也许姐姐上班的时候，爸爸可以教 Chinami 一些东西，让她好受一点?

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s a good idea.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这不是个好主意。

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching32
: It’s not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think that’s...a thing I should be doing here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得……这不是我该在这儿做的事。

lines.en: : Rats.
: We’ve got a big problem on our hands then, Papa.
lines.zh: : 那我们可有大麻烦了，爸爸。

lines.en: : What do you mean we’ve got a big problem on our hands? What kind of problem do we have? I never agreed to tutor anyone. I don’t do that anymore. I don’t-
lines.zh: : 「我们有大麻烦了」是什么意思？我们有什么麻烦？我从没答应过要教任何人。我早就不干这个了。我才不——

lines.en: : But Chinami already told her business partner that you said yes.
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 已经跟她的生意伙伴说你答应了。

lines.en: : You did {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}做了什么?{/i}

lines.en: scene chinamiwatching33
: That must be her now!
lines.zh: : 那一定是她来了!

lines.en: : Chinami-
lines.zh: : Chinami——

lines.en: : Quick, Papa! To the door!
lines.zh: : 快，爸爸!去开门!
